name: Waffle
description: Waffle weave: deep square pockets set in a grid of ridges, each shaded on its upper walls and lit on its lower ones.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background-color: @p(var(--color2), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: inset(4%); clip-path: inset(4%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: var(--color3); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 74.0% 26.0%, 26.0% 26.0%, 26.0% 74.0%, 0.0% 100.0%); clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 74.0% 26.0%, 26.0% 26.0%, 26.0% 74.0%, 0.0% 100.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 100.0%, 26.0% 74.0%, 74.0% 74.0%, 74.0% 26.0%); clip-path: polygon(100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 100.0%, 26.0% 74.0%, 74.0% 74.0%, 74.0% 26.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
